_about: The parks of the stack, in the order they must land (tools/preview/stack.mjs, docs/tools/preview.md). Tools keeps this file from each park's README: add a park here when its folder appears, move it when its order changes, set "ready": false while its owner says it is unfinished (it is left out unless --include-unready). Steps: patch (git apply of a file in the working tree), copy ({from, to}, "replace": true to take the park's file), overlay (working-tree folders an owner has not committed yet, laid over the commit; a folder that already equals the commit counts as landed), manual (a note; an apply script is never run). needs: {park}, {file}, {grep: {in, text}}, {note, owner} (a known gap that is not in the tree: it stays listed as missing until it is taken out of this file). switches: rows {id, file, path, from, to, needs, what} for flags a park adds that the stack should turn on.

parks.notes: The kick and the coin turn (Simulation, 2026-11-01; rule-of-cool-map.md row 23): flat out is 95% of top speed in 2 ticks, a stick flip above half of top speed brakes, plants and kicks the other way. One plain patch on main: sim/core/kick.gd and its check, data/fight/kick.json (enabled false), Netcode's three lines in net/desync.gd and Tools' schema, map row, 4 cases and fixture (both grants given). The preview's `kick` switch turns the data on; ?kick=1 on a local page puts kick true in the setup, ?kick=off false. Off, byte-identical.

needs.note: what it does to escapes and catches is not read: the AI hardly uses it (4 kicks in 3,600 ticks), so QA's rows need a scripted or human player; the view and the pad do not use its two events yet (no dust or thump)

fork_check (Simulation, 2026-11-01): statics a rolled-back branch leaves behind. Six child processes, one at a time, on one real timeline; the surface of every column and the state after eight landings must agree. It FAILS on today's main on purpose (FORK: 3) and lands with World's surface fix (contact-surf-derive), or CI goes red. Copied to sim/core/tools/ here; its doc to docs/architecture/fork-check.md is in its README.
